outputs: auto-generated textual captions for meme images

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset references to 'Hateful Memes', normalized model names, simplified redundant output descriptions, and added NIC model which was mentioned as the underlying caption generation approach
No automatic metrics were used to evaluate the generated captions; the paper focuses on using captions to improve downstream classification performance
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper
No human evaluations of the generated captions were conducted

overall_notes: This paper uses image captioning as an intermediate step/tool to improve hateful meme detection, but does not evaluate the quality of the generated captions themselves. The NLG component (caption generation) serves as feature augmentation rather than being the primary focus of evaluation. The paper mentions human performance (84.7%) on the meme classification task, but this refers to the overall classification accuracy, not evaluation of generated captions.
